### Coaching Philosophies

The goal was not to create several versions of every card, but to understand when a philosophy would actually change the way a card should be structured, selected, or used.

The library also has a shared coaching foundation for ideas that are common across the different approaches. A card is connected to a named philosophy only when that connection adds something meaningful. Small differences in wording are not enough to create a separate philosophy-specific card.

The philosophy profiles are kept together with the shared coaching foundation. Each philosophy has the same small set of files, so the information stays easy to find and each profile follows the same structure.

```text
coaching/
├── coaching_foundation.md
└── philosophies/
    ├── mainstream_endurance/
    │   ├── summary.md
    │   ├── philosophy.md
    │   └── sources.md
    ├── cts/
    │   ├── summary.md
    │   ├── philosophy.md
    │   └── sources.md
    └── ...
```

The basic flow is:

```text
AI coach
    ↓
Coaching foundation and philosophy profiles
    ↓
Training card content
```

### Building the Card Library

We built the library from the larger planning blocks toward the individual sessions. We first defined the Macro structure and prepared the mainstream training approach as a baseline. From there, we reviewed the ideas through the different philosophies and created the Mezzo blocks that belonged inside each Macro phase.

The Micro cards were then built inside the Mezzo structure to describe reusable weekly patterns. Finally, we prepared Session cards that could be reused across different weeks and training blocks. Additional cards were created only when they represented a meaningful alternative, progression, or philosophy-specific idea rather than simply repeating an existing card with different wording.
